name: psych-network-simulation
description: Cross-sectional analytical/Monte Carlo NIRA and dynamic KimNIRA intervention simulations, with focused tutorials and noncausal reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Simulate cross-sectional and dynamic network interventions.
interface.longDescription: Use exact analytical NIRA for tractable binary cross-sectional Ising networks and Monte Carlo only when needed; use KimNIRA for dense binary EMA/ESM dynamics. Includes focused tutorials and model-based, noncausal reporting.
